name: Otblesk
source:
The game is set in an alternate world where the collapse of the USSR did not happen, and instead the country, having passed through the era of stagnation, began a rapid development that gave the people of the Union a world that Soviet sci-fi writers dreamed of: space travel became an everyday occurrence, education and medicine became a model for the whole world, and unique engineering solutions from the pages of futuristic novels began to be implemented in cities.

The protagonist, Sergei, is a Soviet student who has just enrolled in the rocket and space engineering faculty of the country's main university. Sergei's parents went missing during an accident on the space station Zarya; he was just a child then, and any details of what happened remained a government secret.

Sergei has long since given up hope of finding out the truth, but on one of the first days of classes, when the head of the freshman was busy with much more mundane concerns, he learns that a large part of the development of the station was carried out on the grounds of the university. Now, he is determined to continue the investigation and get to the truth, not knowing whether it is out of pure curiosity, a sense of justice, longing for his relatives or some other emotions.

[Translated from [url=https://vkplay.ru/play/game/reflection/]VK Play[/url]]
translation:
游戏设定在另一个世界，苏联没有解体，相反，这个国家度过了停滞时代，开始了快速发展，为苏联人民带来了苏联科幻作家梦想的世界：太空旅行成为日常，教育和医学成为全世界的典范，未来小说中独特的工程解决方案开始在城市中实施。

主人公谢尔盖是一名苏联学生，刚刚就读于该国主要大学的火箭与航天工程系。谢尔盖的父母在查莉娅空间站发生事故时失踪；那时他还只是个孩子，所发生事件的任何细节仍然是政府机密。

谢尔盖早已放弃了查明真相的希望，但在开学的第一天，当这位新生的负责人忙于处理更平凡的事情时，他得知车站的大部分开发工作都是在大学内进行的。现在，他决心继续调查，查明真相，不知道是出于纯粹的好奇，正义感，还是对亲人的思念，还是其他的一些情绪。
